zh.d:
**安装包瘦身一半，媒体产物回到工作区，下载不再变成无名文件。**

【安装与更新】
· 安装包从 462 MB 降到 288 MB，装完占用从 2.28 GB 降到 1.38 GB。去掉的是三类装了也不会被加载的东西：已经被打包进渲染层的依赖在 node_modules 里的第二份副本、应用本身不支持的语言的 Chromium 界面语言包、以及 better-sqlite3 的编译中间产物。应用支持的 13 种语言的系统菜单/右键菜单一个没少
· 支持差分更新：以后升级只下载变化的部分，不再每次重下整个安装包。**升到本版仍是一次完整下载**——差分需要本地缓存上一版安装包，从下一版开始生效

【真实缺陷修复】
· 下载的文件不再变成一个没有名字、扩展名是 `.tmp` 的乱码文件。企业文件库、媒体产物、工具输出、预览面板、差异视图、HTML 导出这六处下载全部受影响——文件其实一直在下载目录里，只是认不出来。同名文件不会互相覆盖，会自动编号
· 生成的图片/视频不再落在「应用被启动的那个目录」。打包版里「没有指定工作区」时的兜底路径一直是失效的，产物落到工作区之外且不报错
· seedream 5 的图片请求会按它的 API 能接受的方式表达尺寸
· 会话历史的批量选择栏不再重复渲染两条
· 被策略拒绝的发送会立刻停下计时并说明原因，不再让对话看起来还在跑
· Windows 上读取机器标识的注册表路径写错了，导致同一台电脑每次重装都被算成一台新机器
· Linux 安装包现在注册 `dream://` 深链。此前只注册了旧的 `aionui://`，浏览器拿到 SSO 回调后无法交还给应用

【界面与本地化】
· 专家市场改为商店式布局，按分类筛选，技能并列展示
· 模型设置里可以看到模型来自哪个渠道，并指定默认的媒体模型
· 模型可以单独指定 OpenAI 兼容接口里 max-tokens 字段的名字
· 「记忆」页面补齐了全部 13 种语言的翻译（此前 11 种语言只有英文）
· 定时任务对话框里，未配置 Dream 引擎渠道的助手选项此前显示的是一串原始的翻译键名，现已修正；同批补上 23 条只有中文硬编码、对非中文用户也显示中文的文案

· 成员侧新增「审批」页面：提交、跟踪、读到审批人的意见。服务端一直有这一半，客户端此前完全够不到
· 项目组页面补上成员自助信息：谁在协作、本机在花名册里的状态、以及撤回自己已分享的会话
· 团队技能同步带上分类与标签，技能中心按分类分组
· 被封禁的运行节点会真正停止同步团队资源
· 关闭企业模式后，已下发的公司资源会在重载后被清理
· 渠道令牌在重载后保持，客户端不再让自己的凭据失效
· 客户端侧的用量会上报，公司的资源不再被呈现为成员自己的资源
· **从企业切回个人工作区时，企业下发的模型渠道现在会被清掉。**此前只广播了「部署角色变了」，而清理逻辑监听的是「所属企业变了」，两个事件不通，渠道就一直留着并被当成用户自己的渠道

⚠️ **公司安全策略在本版仍然不会生效，请不要据此认为已经受控。** 破坏性命令拦截、外网默认拒绝、终端命令审批、发送限流、模型白名单，以及企业记忆的本机召回，执行点都在本机后端（dream-core）里。本版沿用 `v0.1.71-one.3`，还不含这部分——客户端会把管理员配置的策略下发到本机后端，后端不认这个接口，静默忽略。客户端这一半（下发、成员界面）已经就位，等下一次后端发版即可闭环。

en.d:
**Half the installer size, generated media back inside the workspace, and downloads that arrive with a name.**

[Install and update]
· The installer is down from 462 MB to 288 MB, and the installed footprint from 2.28 GB to 1.38 GB. What went was three kinds of payload nothing loads: a second, unreachable copy under node_modules of dependencies already compiled into the renderer bundle, Chromium UI locales for languages the app does not support, and better-sqlite3's compile artefacts. The system and context menus still ship in all 13 languages the app supports
· Differential updates are on: future upgrades download only the blocks that changed instead of the whole installer. **Upgrading to this version is still a full download** — a diff needs the previous installer cached locally, so it takes effect from the next release onward

[Real defects fixed]
· Downloads no longer land as an unnamed GUID with a `.tmp` extension. All six download paths were affected — the enterprise file vault, media results, tool output, the preview panel, the diff viewer and the HTML exporter. The files were always in your downloads folder; they were just unrecognisable. Downloading the same name twice now numbers the second one instead of overwriting the first
· Generated images and video no longer land wherever the app happened to be launched from. The fallback used when no workspace was named was broken in every packaged build, so results were written outside the workspace and nothing said so
· seedream 5 image requests express their size in a form its API accepts
· The batch-selection bar in the history sidebar no longer renders twice
· A send refused by policy now stops the turn clock immediately and says why, instead of leaving the conversation looking like it is still running
· The Windows registry path for the machine identifier was written with unescaped backslashes, so the lookup always failed and every reinstall counted as a new machine
· The Linux package now registers the `dream://` deep link. It previously declared only the legacy `aionui://`, so the browser had nothing to hand the SSO callback back to

[Interface and localisation]
· The expert marketplace has a store-style layout with category filters, and skills sit alongside it
· Model settings show which channel a model comes from, and let you pin the default media model
· A model can name the max-tokens field its OpenAI-compatible endpoint expects
· The Memory page is now translated in all 13 languages (eleven of them were English-only)
· In the scheduled-task dialog, an assistant with no Dream Engine channel configured displayed a raw translation key as its label and tooltip; that is fixed, along with 23 other strings that existed only as hardcoded Chinese and showed Chinese to every non-Chinese user

· A member-facing Approvals page: submit, track, and read the reviewer's note. The server has always had this half and the client could reach none of it
· The project-group page gained member self-service: who you are working with, this machine's standing in the roster, and revoking a conversation you shared
· Team skill sync carries category and tags, and the Skills Hub groups by category
· A blocked runtime node actually stops syncing team resources
· Turning enterprise mode off now purges the materialised company resources across a reload
· The channel token survives a reload, and the client no longer invalidates its own credential
· Client-side spend is reported, and company resources are no longer presented as the member's own
· **Switching from a company back to the personal workspace now clears the enterprise-issued model channels.** Only "the deployment role changed" was being broadcast, while the cleanup listens for "which company I belong to changed" — the two never met, so the channel stayed behind and was offered as the user's own

⚠️ **Company security policy is still not enforced in this build — please do not read it as in effect.** Destructive-command blocking, network default-deny, terminal-command approval, send rate limiting, the model allowlist, and local recall of company memory are all enforced by the on-machine backend (dream-core). This release keeps `v0.1.71-one.3`, which does not carry that half yet: the client pushes the administrator's policy down to the local backend, the backend does not know the endpoint, and the push is silently ignored. The client half — delivery and the member-facing surfaces — is in place and closes the loop as soon as the backend ships.
